coverage.text: Every requirement maps to at least one invariant, task and gate row, and every invariant appears in a task.

terminology.text: The model's words are used throughout. Windows are named the way the constitution's retraction row names them, and phase numbers appear only where existing code uses them.

contradictions-found-and-how-they-are-ca.text: Four findings: the update timing rule outside the model, a separate ticket's repair, kept unchanged here with its claim held; the consumer's R9 conflict, held; CG23's stale timing words, restated; and the builder's phase three documentation, restated with the change.

ambiguities-left-open.text: One remains: whether the consumer conflict holds this repair's merge or only the consumer integration claim. The parent decides it.
